description: Every tax-table figure as a fact tagged with its tax type, jurisdiction and level of government, each with its value (rate, amount or bands), validity dates, status and official source. Filter by country, tax_type (a code or dotted prefix: income.pit, payroll.ss, consumption.), jurisdiction (gb-sct, us-ca, ca-on), level and year, across all 217 countries; for example every US state sales tax rate, or one country's income tax bands. Paginated: pass nextCursor as cursor.

country.description: Country short code or name. Default: every country.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, with the same filters.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction id, exact: gb, gb-sct, us-ca, ca-on (ISO 3166-1/3166-2 based).

level.description: Tier of government that levies the tax.

tax_type.description: Tax type code or dotted prefix, e.g. income.pit, payroll.ss (every social security branch), consumption. (every consumption tax), consumption.sales.state. An unknown type returns the list of top-level types.

year.description: Tax year (e.g. "2026" or "2026-27"), or "latest" for each country's current year. Default: every year served.

name: search_tax_facts

attribution.description: Always "Data by CalcBloc"; show it with the figures.

calcblocUrl.description: The calcbloc.com page for this result.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next facts; null on the last page.

sources.description: Official sources for the rates used.

retrievedAt.description: Date CalcBloc last checked the source.

title: Search tax facts
